headline: Russian missile barrage hits Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Chernivtsi in coordinated assault
subheadline: Eight S-400 ballistic missiles struck Kyiv from the north, damaging Desnianskyi and Dniprovske districts near Lisova metro station, causing civilian casualties.
lede: A high-level security summit in Tehran brought together Iranian, Saudi, Pakistani, and Turkish officials to discuss de‑escalation, with Pakistan and Qatar acting as mediators. Meanwhile, Jordanian Air Force strikes killed five civilians, including women and children, in southern Syria’s Daraa suburbs. In Gaza, Israeli forces eliminated four Hamas and Islamic Jihad operatives, including a sniper and a Nukhba commander, and destroyed a sniper post, while three Palestinian tunnel operatives were detected in Khan Younis. On the Ukrainian front, Russian forces launched a coordinated air and missile assault on Kyiv, Vinnytsia, and Chernivtsi using S-400 ballistic missiles, Geran‑5 cruise missiles, and Shahed drones, inflicting damage to residential areas, metro stations, hospitals, and energy infrastructure.

sections.title: Russian missile barrage targets Kyiv and western Ukraine
sections.body: Eight S-400 ballistic missiles struck Kyiv from the north, causing damage in Desnianskyi and Dniprovske districts, including near the Lisova metro station. Multiple Geran‑5 cruise missiles targeted Vinnytsia, with two confirmed strikes hitting the city and its airport. A Geran‑5 missile struck near the Kotsma substation in Chernivtsi region, causing power outages across Chernivtsi city and surrounding areas. Ukrainian air defenses engaged incoming threats while emergency responders reported casualties and injuries after strikes on residential buildings and medical facilities in Kyiv.

sections.title: Tehran summit seeks de‑escalation amid regional strikes
sections.body: The Tehran security summit hosted Iranian, Saudi, Pakistani, and Turkish leaders, focusing on de‑escalation with mediation by Pakistan and Qatar. Jordanian Air Force strikes killed five civilians, including women and children, in Daraa suburbs, Syria, according to SANA. Israeli forces eliminated four Hamas and Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza, including a sniper and a Nukhba commander, and destroyed a sniper post. Hezbollah spent three months rearming with tens of millions of dollars from Iran, acquiring attack drones, explosives, and rebuilt command structures, per Lebanese sources.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The Russian campaign’s use of S-400 ballistic missiles and Geran‑5 cruise missiles alongside Shahed drones demonstrates a coordinated escalation aimed at overwhelming Ukrainian air defenses and crippling critical infrastructure. Simultaneously, Iran’s missile tests, funding for Hezbollah rearmament, and hosting of a de‑escalation summit reveal a dual strategy of military pressure and diplomatic outreach across the Middle East.
